resources.string: Serve your Hexis tasks and notes to a browser on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing leaves this device until you open the page — the connection is end-to-end encrypted with a pairing key only you have.
Tap “Connect to Hexis” and approve access, then start the server.
Start the server, then scan the QR or open the link on your computer.
Scan the QR with your phone camera, or type the link above into a browser on the same Wi-Fi. The part after “#” is your pairing key — it never leaves your devices.
